svg.title: Four Pre-Flight Decisions Before Commercial Commitment
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-05-preflight-rights-and-risk; chart type: decision_tree; title: Four Pre-Flight Decisions Before Commercial Commitment; subtitle: Proceed on documented evidence; remediate the specific failed check.; chapter number: 5; epistemic tag: operating_framework; assumptions note: Numeric values identify ordered decision nodes, not risk probabilities. Each node states its pass and remediation branches. Apply statutes to the actual rights, transaction, and territory; the checks are not interchangeable across asset classes.; caption: Resolve title, scope, commercial restrictions, and evidence access before promising an exclusive or unrestricted license.; stages: label: Can the operator grant these rights?; value: Pass documented title; otherwise repair ownership evidence; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Review assignments, liens, joint ownership, and sublicensing authority under 35 U.S.C. 261 or 17 U.S.C. 204 as applicable. If authority is supported, continue; otherwise obtain the missing grant or exclude the affected asset.; label: Does the proposed use fit the rights?; value: Pass supported scope; otherwise narrow the licensed grant; numeric value: 2.0; detail: Check territory, duration, patent status, third-party material, and permitted data uses. Apply 17 U.S.C. 102–103 to expression and compilations and 18 U.S.C. 1839 to claimed trade secrets. Proceed only with supported scope.; label: Are commercial restrictions defensible?; value: Pass reviewed terms; otherwise revise restrictive provisions; numeric value: 3.0; detail: Review exclusivity, tying, and resale restrictions under 15 U.S.C. 1 without assuming exclusivity is inherently unlawful. For brand arrangements, assess 16 CFR 436.1 and applicable state franchise rules; resolve classification and required disclosures before execution.; label: Can performance and misuse be detected?; value: Pass inspectable controls; otherwise redesign monitoring terms; numeric value: 4.0; detail: Require royalty records, audit access, retention periods, and enforceable remedies. For trademarks, document quality control relevant to 15 U.S.C. 1055 and 1127. If evidence cannot be inspected, revise terms or decline.

text.tspan: Four Pre-Flight Decisions Before Commercial Commitment

rect.title: label: Can the operator grant these rights?; value: Pass documented title; otherwise repair ownership evidence; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Review assignments, liens, joint ownership, and sublicensing authority under 35 U.S.C. 261 or 17 U.S.C. 204 as applicable. If authority is supported, continue; otherwise obtain the missing grant or exclude the affected asset.

text.title: Can the operator grant these rights?

Review assignments, liens, joint ownership, and sublicensing authority under 35 U.S.C. 261 or 17 U.S.C. 204 as applicable. If authority is supported, continue; otherwise obtain the missing grant or exclude the affected asset.

rect.title: label: Does the proposed use fit the rights?; value: Pass supported scope; otherwise narrow the licensed grant; numeric value: 2.0; detail: Check territory, duration, patent status, third-party material, and permitted data uses. Apply 17 U.S.C. 102–103 to expression and compilations and 18 U.S.C. 1839 to claimed trade secrets. Proceed only with supported scope.

text.title: Does the proposed use fit the rights?

text.title: Check territory, duration, patent status, third-party material, and permitted data uses. Apply 17 U.S.C. 102–103 to expression and compilations and 18 U.S.C. 1839 to claimed trade secrets. Proceed only with supported scope.

rect.title: label: Are commercial restrictions defensible?; value: Pass reviewed terms; otherwise revise restrictive provisions; numeric value: 3.0; detail: Review exclusivity, tying, and resale restrictions under 15 U.S.C. 1 without assuming exclusivity is inherently unlawful. For brand arrangements, assess 16 CFR 436.1 and applicable state franchise rules; resolve classification and required disclosures before execution.

text.title: Review exclusivity, tying, and resale restrictions under 15 U.S.C. 1 without assuming exclusivity is inherently unlawful. For brand arrangements, assess 16 CFR 436.1 and applicable state franchise rules; resolve classification and required disclosures before execution.

rect.title: label: Can performance and misuse be detected?; value: Pass inspectable controls; otherwise redesign monitoring terms; numeric value: 4.0; detail: Require royalty records, audit access, retention periods, and enforceable remedies. For trademarks, document quality control relevant to 15 U.S.C. 1055 and 1127. If evidence cannot be inspected, revise terms or decline.

text.title: Can performance and misuse be detected?

Require royalty records, audit access, retention periods, and enforceable remedies. For trademarks, document quality control relevant to 15 U.S.C. 1055 and 1127. If evidence cannot be inspected, revise terms or decline.

Assumptions: Numeric values identify ordered decision nodes, not risk probabilities. Each node states its pass and remediation branches. Apply statutes to the actual rights, transaction, and territory; the checks are not interchangeable across asset classes.
